context: Dashboard / SaaS App (Internal ERP for Manufacturing)
design_vision: A professional, dense, data-rich industrial ERP system for Lumiasign LLP. It must feel solid, trustworthy, and precise. The design will use a multi-panel operational layout with high information density, clear visual hierarchy, and a classic structural aesthetic over decorative experimentation. No generic gradients or soft shadows; we use sharp borders, high contrast, and functional colors.

typography.rules: Never center headings by default. Left-align dense content. Use tight letter spacing for headings. Use IBM Plex Sans for all tabular data and body text for monospaced-like precision.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing between macro-sections (p-6, p-8) but tight, dense spacing within tables and data widgets (p-2, p-4).
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Use a 'Control Room' grid. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12. Gap: gap-4 or gap-6.
layout_and_spacing.kpi_cards: col-span-full md:col-span-6 lg:col-span-3. Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm max).
layout_and_spacing.main_charts: col-span-full lg:col-span-8 row-span-2. High density, clear axes.
layout_and_spacing.data_tables: col-span-full. Virtualized or heavily paginated. Compact row heights (h-10).
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Collapsible left sidebar for role-gated navigation (Admin, Sales, Production, Store, Accounts, Installation).

component_rules.buttons: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). High contrast. Primary buttons: bg-[#0F3BE8] text-white hover:bg-[#0C2EBA]. No soft shadows, use 1px solid borders if needed.
component_rules.cards: Flat solid background, 1px solid border (border-slate-300), no shadows. On hover: slight border color darkening.
component_rules.tables: Dense. border-collapse. border-b border-slate-200 on rows. Hover state on rows: bg-slate-50.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn UI forms. Square or rounded-sm. Focus state must have high contrast ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0F3BE8]).
component_rules.badges: For status tracking (New, In-Production, Installation, Completed). Sharp edges, bold text. e.g., bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200.
component_rules.tabs: Flat, pill-less. Underline style active states or high-contrast background active states.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must change background or border color on hover. Explicitly set text color.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast and snappy. transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out. No bouncy or slow animations.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use skeleton loaders matching the table/grid structure instead of spinners.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Never use gray-on-gray for essential data.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn', data-testid='sidebar-nav-production').

media.icon_style: Weight 'regular' or 'bold' for active states. Avoid thin/light icons for this dense industrial theme.

images.description: Industrial factory interior, use as a split-screen 50% width background image on the login page with a subtle dark overlay (bg-slate-900/40) so the brand stands out.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI. Override default radii to '0rem' or '0.125rem' (rounded-sm) in tailwind.config.js.
Implement a robust layout shell: a fixed left sidebar for navigation and a top header for global context (user profile, role badge).
For the Login screen: Build a 50/50 split layout. Left side: the provided factory image with a dark overlay. Right side: Login form with role selector.
Dashboard module: Implement KPI cards for Revenue, Profit, Pending Projects, Completed Projects, Low Stock Alerts.
Build the Projects Module as a dense data table or a kanban board using the exact layout spacing guidelines.
Ensure the UI feels 'dense'—do not use large paddings (like p-8) inside data tables. Use tight, tabular spacing.
Add 'data-testid' to every actionable item (buttons, links, form inputs) and dynamic data element (KPI numbers).
